CallStatsCandidate.description: The type of the local candidate of the selected ICE pair (F21; RFC 8445 §5.1.1).

CallStatsClient.description:
The browser family of a call-stats sample (F21): the family only, never a version or a
user agent.

oneOf.description: Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers.

CallStatsRelayProtocol.description: How the browser reaches its TURN relay (F21; `relay` candidates only).

description:
`POST /api/v1/me/voice/stats` body (F21, prd-meet-01 CC14): one aggregate, anonymous
sample of this browser's call over the last `interval_ms`. It names no member, room,
channel, call, track, address, URL, key or SDP (unknown fields are refused); Sew adds it to
`/metrics` families and keeps nothing per person or per call.

candidate.description: The local candidate type of the selected pair (absent before ICE selected one).

decrypt_failures.description: Frames that failed to decrypt in the window (E2EE).

frames_decoded.description: Video frames decoded in the window, summed over received tracks.

frames_dropped.description: Video frames dropped in the window (`framesDropped`).

freeze_ms.description: Time frozen in the window, ms (`totalFreezesDuration`).

interval_ms.description: The window the counts cover, ms (1..=120,000).

rtt_ms.description: The selected pair's current round-trip time, ms (absent when unknown).

title: CallStatsSample
